title: KoreLumina — Master OS - Repo Import Debugging — message 1

metadata.content:
Current task: verify your live preview system is actually working end-to-end

Step 1 — Confirm files exist
Run:
Bashls app/api/dev/live-preview
Expected:
Bashmanager.ts
watcher.ts
route.ts
If anything missing → stop and fix.

Step 2 — Start main app
Bashnpm run dev
Make sure:


no build errors


API routes compiled



Step 3 — Trigger live preview (critical test)
Open your builder UI and select a project.
👉 This should call:
POST /api/dev/live-preview

Step 4 — Watch terminal logs
You should see:
📦 Installing dependencies... (only first run)
🚀 Launching korelumina-dogfood on 34xx
Then:
ready / started / Local:

Step 5 — Verify iframe loads
Expected result:


NOT blank


actual app renders


routes work


no supabase errors



Step 6 — Test hot reload
Edit any file inside the repo:
Bashruntime/workspaces/default/projects/<projectId>/app/page.tsx
Expected:
👀 Watching project: ...
🔁 Change detected: app/page.tsx
Then:


server killed


next request restarts it


preview updates



If something fails
Case A — preview never loads
Check:
Bashlsof -i :3400
If nothing → server didn’t start

Case B — install hangs
Run manually:
Bashcd runtime/workspaces/default/projects/<projectId>
npm install

Case C — Next never ready
Check logs for:


missing env vars


port conflicts


script mismatch



What success looks like
You now have:


real repo rendering ✅


multi-framework support ✅


auto dependency install ✅


hot reload ✅


process isolation ✅



Important checkpoint
If this works:
👉 KoreLumina is now a real runtime platform, not just a builder

Next step (only after this passes)
Say:
👉 “add UI control panel (logs + restart + status)”
That’s the final layer to make it elite-level.
